classes.name: Alps
classes.brief:
Core definitions for ALPS parallel tree search framework

Central header defining enumerations, constants, and types for the
Abstract Library for Parallel Search (ALPS).

**Core enumerations:**
- AlpsNodeStatus: Node states (Candidate, Evaluated, Pregnant, Branched, Fathomed)
- AlpsSearchType: Search strategies (BestFirst, BreadthFirst, DepthFirst, Hybrid)
- AlpsKnowledgeType: Knowledge categories (Model, Node, Solution, SubTree)
- AlpsExitStatus: Termination status (Optimal, TimeLimit, NodeLimit, etc.)
- AlpsPhase: Execution phase (Rampup, Search, Rampdown)

**Key constants:**
- ALPS_OBJ_MAX, ALPS_BND_MAX: Numerical bounds
- ALPS_ZERO, ALPS_GEN_TOL: Numerical tolerances

**Design philosophy:**
- Subtree is the basic unit of work in parallel execution
- Workers process subtrees autonomously
- Hub brokers coordinate work distribution

classes.name: AlpsAix43
classes.brief:
Platform-specific definitions for IBM AIX 4.3

Provides AIX-specific system includes, type definitions, and compiler
macros for the ALPS parallel search framework. Includes gettimeofday(),
getrusage(), and memory management macros for GCC and IBM compilers.

classes.name: AlpsConfig
classes.brief:
Unified configuration header for Alps library

Main entry point for Alps configuration that routes to the appropriate
settings based on build environment. With autotools (HAVE_CONFIG_H),
includes generated config.h. Without autotools, uses config_default.h
for building or config_alps_default.h for clients. Sets up ALPSLIB_EXPORT
for proper DLL import/export on Windows and GCC visibility.

classes.name: AlpsCygwin
classes.brief:
Platform-specific definitions for Cygwin (Windows POSIX layer)

Provides Cygwin-specific system includes, type definitions, and compiler
macros. Disables setpriority() (not available on Cygwin), defines memory
management macros for GCC 2.x vs 3.x+.

classes.name: AlpsEncoded
classes.brief:
Serialization buffer for ALPS knowledge objects

AlpsEncoded is the binary buffer for packing/unpacking AlpsKnowledge
objects for network transmission in parallel search.

**Buffer structure:**
- type_: Integer identifying the knowledge type
- size_: Current data size in bytes
- representation_: Raw byte buffer
- pos_: Current read position

**Template methods for serialization:**
- writeRep(T): Write single value
- readRep(T): Read single value
- writeRep(T*, len): Write array with length prefix
- readRep(T*, len): Read array
- writeRep/readRep for std::string, std::vector

**Memory management:**
- Default: 16KB initial allocation
- make_fit(): Grows buffer as needed (4x growth)
- clear(): Reset buffer to empty state

Based on BCP_buffer and CoinEncoded designs.

classes.name: AlpsEnumProcessT
classes.brief:
Process type enumeration for parallel search

Defines AlpsProcessType enum identifying roles in distributed computing:
Serial (single process), Master (coordinator), Hub (cluster manager),
Worker (search executor), and specialized generators (CG/VG cut/variable,
CP/VP constraint/variable pool managers).

classes.name: AlpsHelperFunctions
classes.brief:
Utility functors and helper functions for ALPS

Provides TotalWorkload functor for computing workload estimates across
node pools (used in load balancing), DeletePtrObject functor for cleanup,
and AlpsSleep() for CPU-based delays. Used internally by node pool and
load balancing mechanisms.

classes.name: AlpsKnowledge
classes.brief:
Base class for all ALPS knowledge types (Model, Node, Solution, SubTree)

AlpsKnowledge is the abstract base for all sharable data in parallel search.
Derived classes must implement encode()/decode() for serialization.

**Knowledge types (AlpsKnowledgeType):**
- Model: Problem data shared at initialization
- Node: Search tree nodes processed by workers
- Solution: Feasible solutions found during search
- SubTree: Collections of nodes for work distribution

**Serialization for parallel execution:**
- encode(): Pack object into AlpsEncoded buffer
- decode(): Create new object from AlpsEncoded
- decodeToSelf(): Unpack into existing object

Simple contiguous classes can use default encode/decode.
Classes with pointers or STL containers must override.

classes.name: AlpsKnowledgeBroker
classes.brief:
Central manager for parallel tree search knowledge and coordination

AlpsKnowledgeBroker is the abstract base class for search coordination.
It manages knowledge pools, search strategy, and execution statistics.

classes.name: AlpsKnowledgeBrokerMPI
classes.brief:
MPI-based parallel implementation of ALPS knowledge broker

AlpsKnowledgeBrokerMPI provides scalable parallel tree search using MPI.
Implements hierarchical Master-Hub-Worker architecture.

**Process hierarchy:**
- Master (rank 0): Inter-cluster load balancing, termination detection
- Hubs: Manage worker clusters, intra-cluster load balancing
- Workers: Process subtrees, report status to hub

**Core methods per process type:**
- masterMain(): Balance hubs, check termination
- hubMain(): Balance workers, report to master
- workerMain(): Explore subtrees, request work

**Load balancing:**
- Inter-cluster: Master moves work between hubs
- Intra-cluster: Hub moves work between workers
- Work donation: Split subtrees when requested

**Static initialization schemes:**
- Root initialization: Master generates nodes, distributes
- Spiral: Distribute initial work in spiral pattern

**MPI communicators:**
- MPI_COMM_WORLD: All processes
- clusterComm_: Hub and its workers
- hubComm_: Master and all hubs

classes.name: AlpsKnowledgeBrokerSerial
AlpsKnowledgePool
classes.brief:
Abstract base class for knowledge storage pools

AlpsKnowledgePool defines the API for all pool types in ALPS.
Knowledge is stored with associated priority values for ordering.

**Pool types (AlpsKnowledgePoolType):**
- NodePool: Stores tree nodes awaiting processing
- SolutionPool: Stores feasible solutions found
- SubTreePool: Stores subtrees for parallel distribution

**Core API:**
- addKnowledge(kl, priority): Add with ordering priority
- getKnowledge(): Peek at highest-priority item
- popKnowledge(): Remove highest-priority item
- getBestKnowledge(): Get best quality item
- hasKnowledge(): Check if pool is non-empty

classes.name: AlpsLicense
classes.brief:
License and copyright header for ALPS library

Contains the standard ALPS copyright notice and Eclipse Public License
header. Included for license compliance in source distributions.

classes.name: AlpsLinux
classes.brief:
Platform-specific definitions for Linux systems

Provides Linux-specific system includes, type definitions, and compiler
macros for GCC 2.x and 3.x+. Includes gettimeofday(), setpriority(),
gethostname(), and memory management macros (ALPS_CONSTRUCT, ALPS_DESTROY).

classes.name: AlpsMACH
classes.brief:
Platform-specific definitions for macOS (Darwin/Mach)

Provides macOS-specific system includes, type definitions, and compiler
macros for GCC on Darwin kernel. Includes gettimeofday(), setpriority(),
gethostname(), and memory management macros for GCC 2.x vs 3.x+.

classes.name: AlpsMessage
classes.brief:
Log messages for ALPS search status and events

Defines ALPS_Message enum for CoinMessageHandler logging.
NOT the MPI message tags (see AlpsMessageTag.h).

**Message categories:**
- ALPS_DONATE_*: Work donation events
- ALPS_LOADBAL_*: Load balancing status
- ALPS_RAMPUP_*: Initial distribution phase
- ALPS_TERM_*: Termination detection
- ALPS_S_*: Serial-only messages
- ALPS_T_*: Termination reasons

**AlpsMessage class:**
Extends CoinMessages with ALPS-specific message definitions.
Used with CoinMessageHandler for consistent logging.

classes.name: AlpsMessageTag
classes.brief:
MPI message tag enumeration for parallel search

Defines 45+ AlpsMessageTag values for inter-process communication in
distributed tree search. Categories include:
- Control: termination, pause, continue (AlpsMsgContOrTerm, AlpsMsgAskTerminate)
- Load balancing: donate requests, workload sharing (AlpsMsgAskDonate, AlpsMsgLoadInfo)
- Status: hub/worker status reporting (AlpsMsgHubStatus, AlpsMsgWorkerStatus)
- Data: model/node/subtree transfer (AlpsMsgModel, AlpsMsgNode, AlpsMsgSubTree)

classes.name: AlpsModel
classes.brief:
Abstract base class for user problem data in ALPS tree search

AlpsModel holds problem-specific data (constraints, objectives, variables).
Users inherit this class and implement virtual methods for their application.

**Key virtual methods to implement:**
- readInstance(): Read problem from file (master process only)
- setupSelf(): Initialize model after data loaded/received
- preprocess(): Preprocessing before search
- createRoot(): Create the root tree node
- encode()/decodeToSelf(): Serialize for parallel distribution

**Parallel execution flow:**
1. Master: readInstance() → setupSelf() → preprocess() → createRoot()
2. Master: encode() model and send to workers
3. Workers: decodeToSelf() → setupSelf() → begin processing nodes
4. All: postprocess() after search completes

classes.name: AlpsNodeDesc
classes.brief:
Node description holding subproblem-specific data

AlpsNodeDesc holds problem data for a tree node separate from tree
structure data. Users inherit this class for application-specific data.

**Design rationale:**
- AlpsTreeNode: Tree structure (parent, children, status)
- AlpsNodeDesc: Subproblem data (bounds, constraints, etc.)

This separation simplifies parallel communication: only the
description needs to be encoded for node transfer.

**Representation modes:**
- Explicit: Full problem data stored
- Relative: Differences from parent node

classes.name: AlpsNodePool
classes.brief:
Priority queue for tree nodes awaiting processing

AlpsNodePool stores candidate nodes ordered by search strategy.
Uses AlpsPriorityQueue with AlpsSearchStrategy comparison.

**Storage:**
- candidateList_: Priority queue of AlpsTreeNode pointers
- searchStrategy_: Comparison function for ordering

**Key operations:**
- addKnowledge(): Add node with quality as priority
- getKnowledge()/popKnowledge(): Access/remove best node
- setNodeSelection(): Change search strategy (re-heaps)
- getBestNode(): Get node with best quality

**Search strategies supported:**
- BestFirst: Lowest quality value first
- DepthFirst: Deepest node first
- BreadthFirst: Shallowest node first
- BestEstimate: Best estimated solution first

classes.name: AlpsOs
classes.brief:
Platform detection and routing for ALPS

Detects the current operating system and includes the appropriate
platform-specific header. Supports Linux (AlpsLinux.h), Cygwin
(AlpsCygwin.h), AIX 4.3 (AlpsAix43.h), SunOS (AlpsSunos.h), and
macOS/Darwin (AlpsMACH.h).

classes.name: AlpsParameterBase
classes.brief:
Generic parameter management infrastructure for ALPS

Base classes for defining and parsing typed parameter sets.
Derived from BCP_parameters.hpp design.

**AlpsParameterT enum:**
- AlpsBoolPar, AlpsIntPar, AlpsDoublePar, AlpsStringPar
- AlpsStringArrayPar: Multiple values per key

**AlpsParameter class:**
Identifies a single parameter by type and index within type.

**AlpsParameterSet class:**
Container for typed parameter arrays with file parsing.
Subclasses must implement:
- createKeywordList(): Define keyword→parameter mappings
- setDefaultEntries(): Set default values

**Reading parameters:**
- readFromFile(): Parse parameter file
- readFromStream(): Parse from istream
- readFromArglist(): Parse command-line args

classes.name: AlpsParams
classes.brief:
Parameter set for ALPS tree search configuration

AlpsParams extends AlpsParameterSet with ALPS-specific parameters.
Parameters control search strategy, limits, load balancing, and logging.

**Boolean parameters (boolParams):**
- deleteDeadNode: Remove fathomed nodes (default: true)
- interClusterBalance: Master balances hubs (default: true)
- intraClusterBalance: Hub balances workers (default: true)

**Integer parameters (intParams):**
- nodeLimit: Max nodes to process (default: INT_MAX)
- solLimit: Max solutions to store (default: INT_MAX)
- searchStrategy: 0=best, 1=estimate, 2=BFS, 3=DFS, 4=hybrid
- msgLevel: Output verbosity (0=none, 1=summary, 2=moderate, 3=verbose)
- hubNum: Number of hub processes
- unitWorkNodes: Nodes per work unit

**Double parameters (dblParams):**
- timeLimit: Max search time in seconds
- tolerance: Numerical tolerance (default: 1e-6)
- donorThreshold/receiverThreshold: Load balancing thresholds

classes.name: AlpsPriorityQueue
classes.brief:
Template priority queue with dynamic comparison function

Provides AlpsPriorityQueue template class that wraps std::vector with
heap operations, supporting dynamic comparison function changes. Used
for node pool management where search strategy can change at runtime
(best-first, depth-first, breadth-first, etc.).

classes.name: AlpsSearchStrategy
classes.brief: Node and subtree selection strategies for ALPS tree search

classes.name: AlpsSearchStrategyBase
classes.brief:
Template base class for search strategy comparison functions

Defines the template interface for node and subtree comparison.
Used in priority queues to order items for selection.

**AlpsSearchStrategy<T> template:**
- compare(x, y): Return true if y preferred over x
- operator(): Calls compare() for STL compatibility
- weight_: Optional parameter for tuning
- type_: Strategy identifier (BestFirst, DFS, etc.)

**Virtual methods for advanced strategies:**
- selectNextNode(): Custom node selection logic
- createNewNodes(): Custom branching logic

**AlpsCompare<T> wrapper:**
Adapter holding strategy pointer for use with std::priority_queue.
Used in AlpsPriorityQueue.

classes.name: AlpsSolution
classes.brief:
Base class for solutions found during ALPS tree search

AlpsSolution is the abstract base class for feasible solutions.
Users inherit this class to store application-specific solution data.

**Base class data:**
- index_: Node index where solution was found
- depth_: Tree depth where solution was found

**Key virtual methods:**
- print(): Output solution to stream
- encode()/decodeToSelf(): Serialize for parallel sharing

Solutions are stored in AlpsSolutionPool with their quality values.
The incumbent (best solution) is tracked and used for pruning.

classes.name: AlpsSolutionPool
classes.brief:
Storage for feasible solutions found during search

AlpsSolutionPool stores solutions ordered by quality (priority).
Lower priority value = better solution (for minimization).

**Storage:**
- solutions_: multimap<double, AlpsSolution*> ordered by quality
- maxNumSolutions_: Maximum solutions to retain

**Key operations:**
- addKnowledge(): Add solution, possibly discard worst if at limit
- getBestKnowledge(): Get solution with lowest priority (best)
- getAllKnowledges(): Get all solutions for output
- clean(): Delete all solutions

**AlpsSolutionInterface macro:**
Convenience macro defining getNumSolutions, getBestSolution, etc.
for use in classes that contain a solution pool.

classes.name: AlpsSubTree
classes.brief:
Subtree management for ALPS parallel tree search

AlpsSubTree is the basic unit of work in parallel ALPS. Workers process
entire subtrees autonomously, enabling scalable parallelism.

classes.name: AlpsSubTreePool
classes.brief:
Pool of subtrees for work distribution in parallel search

AlpsSubTreePool stores subtrees for load balancing between processes.
Key component for parallel scalability in ALPS.

**Storage:**
- subTreeList_: Priority queue of AlpsSubTree pointers
- Ordering by subtree quality for work distribution

**Key operations:**
- addKnowledge(): Add subtree from work donation
- getKnowledge()/popKnowledge(): Get subtree for processing
- setComparison(): Set subtree selection strategy
- getBestQuality(): Get quality of best subtree

**Parallel use:**
- Serial: Single subtree in pool
- Parallel: Multiple subtrees for load balancing
- Subtrees split/merged for work sharing

classes.name: AlpsSunos
classes.brief:
Platform-specific definitions for SunOS/Solaris (SPARC)

Provides SunOS-specific system includes, type definitions, and compiler
macros for GCC on SPARC architecture. Includes gettimeofday(), setpriority(),
gethostname(), and memory management macros.

classes.name: AlpsTime
classes.brief:
Timer utilities for ALPS search (CPU and wall clock)

Provides timing functions and AlpsTimer class for measuring execution time.

**Free functions:**
- AlpsCpuTime(): Alias for CoinCpuTime()
- AlpsGetTimeOfDay(): Wall clock (MPI_Wtime if MPI, else CoinGetTimeOfDay)

**AlpsTimer class:**
- start()/stop(): Control timing interval
- getCpuTime()/getWallClockTime(): Get elapsed time
- getTime(): Returns CPU or wall based on clockType_
- reachCpuLimit()/reachWallLimit(): Check time limits
- setLimit(): Set time limit for checks

**Clock types (AlpsClockType):**
- AlpsClockTypeCpu: Process CPU time
- AlpsClockTypeWallClock: Real elapsed time (default)

classes.name: AlpsTreeNode
classes.brief:
Search tree node abstraction for ALPS parallel tree search

AlpsTreeNode represents a single node in the search tree. Users inherit
this class to implement application-specific node processing.

**Node status lifecycle (AlpsNodeStatus):**
- Candidate: Waiting in pool for processing
- Evaluated: Processed, waiting for branching decision
- Pregnant: Ready to branch, has child descriptions
- Branched: Children created and added to pool
- Fathomed: Pruned (by bound, infeasibility, or solution)

**Key virtual methods:**
- process(): Perform bounding operation (e.g., LP solve)
- branch(): Create child nodes from pregnant node
- createNewTreeNode(): Factory for child node creation

**Node data:**
- quality_: Node quality for selection (lower = better)
- solEstimate_: Estimated solution quality
- desc_: AlpsNodeDesc holding problem-specific data
- explicit_: 1=full description, 0=relative/diff

classes.name: config_alps_default
classes.brief:
Public Alps version macros for non-autotools builds

Defines version information (ALPS_VERSION, ALPS_VERSION_MAJOR/MINOR/RELEASE)
and optional MPI availability (COIN_HAS_MPI). This is the public header
included by users of the Alps library when not using autotools.

classes.name: config_default
classes.brief:
Default build configuration for Alps without autotools

Provides configuration for builds not using the configure script.
Includes system-specific settings via configall_system.h and public
version macros. Defines debug levels (COIN_ALPS_CHECKLEVEL, VERBOSITY)
and package dependencies (ALPS_HAS_COINUTILS, ALPS_HAS_CLP).
